game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Coastal Port – Fish Market, a fish market full of crates: the shipwright must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of jellyfish swarms, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Fish Market: a fish market full of crates
core_gameplay_loop: In Fish Market, repeat each round: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of jellyfish swarms, dodge the other. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the hero_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about hero_hp to power up the shipwright and open the ferry.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 8 (extended tier): Else Escape
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Else Escape' (Week 3 slot 2), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Fish Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how hero_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Fish Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
